_reason: channel-wise L2 feature normalization before cost-volume construction was aggregate-monotone weak(none)>strong(l2) on the OLD SYNTHETIC stereo data (see git history) but does NOT survive re-anchoring on REAL Middlebury Stereo Datasets 2005/2006 rectified photographs: GPU re-anchor (k1 H20, seed 42, 1200 steps) is clean, but seed 123 at 1200 steps is FULLY inverted on all 3 settings (weak<strong everywhere).
